opening.argument: Judge, the trading pitch links a claimed benefit to a concrete action: viewers are told they can get a deposit bonus and additional funds on a trade, then directed to the link below. The same pitch invites leverage trading and emphasizes “no KYC no VPN.” That is more than a passing discussion of AVAX's price; it gives viewers a reason to follow an external trading link and put money at risk. The disclosed partnership explains why the speaker benefits when viewers use it, but it does not establish what a viewer must do to qualify for the advertised benefits.
